name: mischievous_mystic_only_your_second_draw
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying.' Turn 1: seat 0 casts Quick Study (draw two; seat 0 skipped its first draw step): its second draw makes one Faerie. Turn 2 (seat 1's): seat 1 draws for the turn and casts Quick Study, its second and third cards: not seat 0's draws, no Faerie; seat 0 casts Opt, its first card that turn: no Faerie. One Faerie in all.
